mapper.select: SELECT qq.concept_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN quizzes q ON q.id = qa.quiz_id JOIN analyses a ON a.id = q.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN quiz_answers ans ON ans.attempt_id = qa.id AND ans.is_correct = FALSE JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.id = ans.question_id AND qq.concept_id IS NOT NULL WHERE qa.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY qq.concept_id
SELECT DISTINCT ac.concept_id FROM analyses a JOIN analysis_concepts ac ON ac.analysis_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT concept_id FROM review_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY concept_id HAVING SUM(status = 'DONE') > 0 AND SUM(status = 'TODO') = 0
